summary: Carry Codex disconnect classification through approval-aware harness publication

replay.detail: No replay cursor, transcript or delivery ledger format changes.

compatibility.detail: The publication helper receives the typed Codex state needed to classify completed retryable connection errors on the current approval-aware control path. This resolves a merge-group compile conflict while preserving the approved connection and human-approval projections.

recovery.detail: No historical claim rewrite or graph repair is required. The conflict was caught before merging the driver fix.
